styleReference.name: Enriched Life Essence option 4: Radiant burst

items.name: Enriched Life Essence
items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Rabbit Lands Enriched Life Essence inventory-icon EXPLORATION, one alternative. Edit the supplied CURRENT enriched life essence painting. Preserve its recognizable emerald-green and warm lime leaf-shaped teardrop, inward curled sprout tip, broad matte hand-painted planes, yellow-green luminous heart, orientation and full silhouette. Add a clearly readable magical effect AROUND the essence to distinguish its rare enriched status. Keep the essence itself dominant, occupying about 60 to 65 percent of the square canvas height, with the complete essence plus surrounding effect inside the central 82 percent. Leave clean transparent margin on all sides. Effect must still read when the complete asset is reduced to 50x50 pixels: prefer a few large painterly particles or broad clean energy strokes, not micro speckles. Match the same chunky hand-painted Oldcraft fantasy finish. Keep dark and middle green planes; do not turn the entire essence white. True transparent background, preserve alpha. No bottle, scenery, hands, pedestal, metal ring, decorative border, UI frame, text, labels, numbers, watermark, or extra essence. Surrounding particles requested below ARE intentional; they should feel like condensed life magic, not generic cinematic visual noise. Surrounding effect: a compact irregular SUNBURST of six to eight short tapered painterly light rays behind and around the essence, pale warm lime-gold with restrained ivory centers. Rays have varied lengths and visible gaps, extending just beyond the body, strongest behind its middle and top. Add two crisp four-point glints outside the silhouette. A rare-item radiance burst, no circular badge, no opaque backdrop.
items.review: Complete recognizable school silhouette and palette, with the selected compact radiant burst and two star glints. Inspected at full resolution and 50px; the rare effect reads clearly without clipping or obscuring the essence.
